svg.title: Ananya traces a clinic telephone circuit through the manual exchange.
svg.desc: An amber patch cord connects the clinic line through old relays. Ananya and Riju follow the same route in the first circuit book, discovering a dependency absent from the modern diagram.
svg.text: Page 18, panel 2 · Close side shot of Ananya tracing one patch circuit

text.tspan: Ananya proves that the manual exchange is an
undocumented dependency, not a museum piece.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
